annotations.title: Vergabestelle oder Firma nach Namen finden

description: Find contracting authorities (Vergabestellen) and companies by name or its beginning, e.g. "Stadt Köln", "Fraunhofer", "WISAG". Returns name, city, slug and page URL for get_buyer and get_company_awards, the most active first. Only organisations with a page in the index; sole traders are never listed.

name.description: Name or its beginning, at least three characters

type.description: Only Vergabestellen (buyer) or only companies; both by default
